channels.title: External channels
channels.subtitle: External conversation gateways (Telegram, Teams) linked to projects. Messages route to the Chief's durable inbox with zero duplication.

empty.title: No channel linked to a project
empty.body: Having a configured Telegram bot on the gateway is not the same as having a linked channel. This screen lists only external-identity → project links. Link your chat below so its messages reach the Chief's durable inbox.

error.title: Could not load channels
error.body: The channels gateway did not respond. Retry in a moment.

concepts.title: Configured bot ≠ linked channel
concepts.body: Configuring the bot (BotFather token on the gateway) only enables Telegram on the server. For a conversation to become work, you must link the chat identity to a project — that is what this screen shows. If you already talk to the bot but see nothing here, the link has not been created in this tenant yet.

link.title: Link a channel to a project
link.subtitle: Link a chat identity (Telegram/Teams) to a project. Linking is idempotent: re-linking the same identity returns the existing link.

fields.identityHintTelegram: Numeric Telegram chat id (e.g. 5774120296). The bot reports the chat id on the first message from a not-yet-linked chat. Never paste the bot token here.

link.success: Channel linked to the project. New chat messages will now reach the Chief's inbox.
link.noProjects: Create a project before linking a channel — a link always points to a project.

errors.invalid_external_identity: External identity is required and limited to 200 characters.
errors.project_not_found: The selected project no longer exists.
errors.generic: Could not link the channel. Check the data and try again.

cli.title: Prefer the CLI/gateway?
cli.intro: The link can also be created directly on the gateway API. Telegram walkthrough:
cli.step1: 1. Enable the bot on the server (once): set the BotFather token before starting the Host.
cli.step2: 2. Find the chat id: send any message to the bot; it replies with the numeric chat id of the not-yet-linked chat.
cli.step3: 3. Create the link (kind telegram, externalIdentity = chat id, projectId = project ULID):
cli.note: The bot token stays on the server (environment variable). It is never sent or shown on this screen — here we only use the chat id (external identity).

messages.title: Message history
messages.subtitle: Recent messages exchanged over this channel.
messages.empty: No messages on this channel yet.
messages.select: Select a channel to see its message history.

manage.title: Manage
manage.unlinkNote: Unlinking a channel is done via the gateway/CLI (there is no delete action on this screen). While the link exists, chat messages keep reaching the Chief's inbox.
